summary: First-finish latency-sensitive test of MorphCut. All 11 backend endpoints working end-to-end: root reports provider_is_mock=true, upload/video and upload/photo accept valid files and reject bad ext/mime (HTTP 400), job created, progress advanced through STAGES to preview_ready in ~7s, preview returned as video/mp4, download without payment returns 402, Stripe checkout returns checkout_url + session_id and inserts payment_transactions with status=initiated/pending, status endpoint returns pending, after direct DB mark of paid the download returned MP4 bytes (200 video/mp4), contact persisted, /api/admin/stats unauthenticated returns 401. Frontend: Landing renders hero + 4,99 € + FAQ; /create shows 2 dropzones + consent checkbox; /admin/login shows Google sign-in button. No console errors.
passed: POST /api/jobs -> 200 status=created; polling reaches preview_ready in ~7s with has_preview=true
POST /api/payments/checkout -> 200 checkout_url + session_id; payment_transactions row status=initiated/pending
After DB mark paid: GET /api/jobs/{id}/download -> 200 video/mp4
Frontend /create has 2 file inputs + consent checkbox
Frontend /admin/login shows 'Se connecter avec Google' button
notes: Face-swap provider is MOCKED (returns uploaded video bytes unchanged) as designed.
Stripe checkout hosted page not opened in tests per instructions; only creation + DB-simulated paid flow validated.
Admin Google auth positive path not testable without real Google session; only 401 on protected endpoint verified.
